page.overview:
Who is Jed?

Jed is a character from Stranger of Paradise Final Fantasy Origin. He is a companion of Jack, whose goal is to kill Chaos.

Jed arrived in Cornelia alongside Jack and Ash, who revealed their Dark Crystals to each other. They set off to kill monsters to gain the trust of the King of Cornelia and let them enter the Chaos Shrine.

Eventually, it was revealed that Jed originated from the Lufenian realm of Paradise. Jed's true identity was that an agent of the "Strangers" program, which was dedicated to eradicating the darkness to create a utopia for the Lufenians while using Cornelia as an experimental dumping ground for excess darkness. Jed and his companions eventually learned of this truth and collaborated with Jack Garland to wrest Lufenia's control over Cornelia by training the Warriors of Light to vanquish the darkness. To that end, Jed became the water fiend Kraken.

Jed is a young man of medium height, light skin, and slim constitution. His eyes are aqua blue. His dark red hair is medium length and is swept to the right, with some bangs framing the right side of his face. Jed has pierced earlobes and wears metal nubs.
